tasks.answer: Use flight-delay.FlightDelayEventCreateScreen from '@/features/flight-delay-compensation/event-create-screen' as the page: it creates a flight delay event with flight, catalog and price-preview form fields, takes no required props, and needs router/query/i18n context (it persists a local draft before submitting). Compose the page's form sections inside ui.UiCard from '@/components/ui/layout' — a card container with optional title/extra and interactive variant, no required props, children required (onClick makes it interactive and implies the interactive variant). Both roles were present in the single search result, so neither is missing.

notes: One catalog search only ('创建航班延误事件页面 卡片', --limit 5 --details --per-layer 3), no get, no second search, no file reads. catalogCalls counted as the single executed search invocation; log at /tmp/audit-a3/2/usage.jsonl.
